issues: All 25 packet records (23 targets plus contexts 345 and 346) were read in full, including every retained body paragraph, header/date audit or fallback audit record, editorial summary and editorial footnotes. Preserved HTML bodies were read directly; metadata transcription flags were not used as body availability decisions.
Official Geological Society material referenced by 347/361/483/496 is distinguished from personal letters; external papers, speeches, books and committee actions are not treated as letter voices.

DCP-LETT-698 is a catalogue-derived printed extract with bracketed editorial framing, and 725 is an excerpt with ellipses; neither is treated as a complete original body. Unidentified family and personal letters retain uncertain recipients and broad/open date holds.

Three supported direct replies are proposed: 346→345 (context family reply), 409A→408F (same-day Gould gift acknowledgement), and 506→504 (Whewell marriage-gift acknowledgement). No incoming author prose is treated as Darwin voice, and no receipt date is inferred from sent-date adjacency.

Missing external items include Whewell’s technical/secretaryship communications, Caroline/Herbert/Gould/Jenyns antecedents, Dieffenbach’s incoming letters and full 698/725 originals, plus institutional Council communications around official records.
